brief: @buildthis.bisks.net list of notable people who died before it became entirely possible to just talk to a computer giving it natural language instructions, especially those who would have liked that or found it surprising
note: built toolatetotalk.bisks.net: 13 people who died before you could just talk to a computer in plain sentences — Steve Jobs died the day after Siri shipped, Hawking missed predictive-text-for-speech by a few years.
